fullText:
RAG is so back!

This work shows that plain RAG over raw chat history beats complex agentic memory systems on most long-term memory benchmarks.

(bookmark it)

They tested Raw-RAG, which is just dense retrieval plus reranking over the raw conversation, feeding a reader LLM.

Across LoCoMo, LongMemEval, MEME and MemoryAgentBench, it ranks first in six of seven benchmark and model settings, ahead of the strongest agentic memory system by 0.13 to 5.53 points. Ingestion on BEAM-1M takes 0.3 hours, against 3.2 to 27 hours for systems like Mem0, MemOS and Memora.

Why does it hold up? Raw history keeps more of the evidence a question needs, including the relations and dependency paths behind an answer. Rewriting history into memory entries tends to drop those important bits.

Even with complete access to the transformed memory stores, models answer less accurately than with raw evidence.

Before adding a memory layer to your agent, at least run this baseline on your own data.

https://t.co/4Fw1at4whN

Chat with Paper: https://t.co/XJyaqjw0LE

fullText:
Stay safe online.

Here is what I do:

1. I use a password manager (Passwords, which comes preinstalled on Apple's ecosystem)

2. I have 2FA enabled everywhere.

3. If the site supports hardware keys, that's what I use. I have 3 YubiKeys 5C. I keep them in different locations. These keys are a bit more inconvenient, but they make it 1000x harder for anyone in the world to access your stuff.

4. If there is no hardware key support, I enable Passkeys and store them on my computer or phone.

5. I do not send authentication codes via text messages unless there's no other alternative to enable 2FA. SMS codes are vulnerable to SIM swapping and interception.

6. My iPhone uses an alphanumeric password. This is much better than a simple 6-digit PIN.

7. I also use a long, complex password on my laptop. It's inconvenient, but if someone steals it, they'll have a hard time breaking in.

8. I enabled Number Lock and SIM Protection with my phone carrier so hackers can't swap my SIM or steal my phone number.

9. I enabled Stolen Device Protection on my iPhone.

10. I have full disk encryption on every device that supports it (starting with my laptop and phone).

11. I have automatic updates enabled on my computers and my phone. I never skip an update, and also update the browser every time I get the notification.

12. I check every critical account every 3 months and make sure security is updated. Critical accounts are your bank, email, social media, and investment accounts. I make sure I don't have old emails, 2FA using SMS, etc.

fullText:
微软研究院新发布了：Flint-interactive，让AI生成的图表能点击、筛选、联动，生成可交互的数据分析界面

非常适合需要反复筛选比较、研究数据的场景，比如商业分析、金融研究、科研、AI数据助手等等

Flint-interactive等于是微软给之前的Flint扩展了交互能力，之前是让AI画的图可靠，这次是让AI画可靠的交互图表

描述语言定义交互行为，实现点击筛选、跨图联动、关联内容高亮等，不必每次从零编写前端交互代码

它有几个能力：
1、交互预设，能让AI快速实现点击筛选、框选数据、跨图表联动等的交互

比如说，生成两张不同年份的经济数据散点图，在第一张图框选部分国家，第二张图就自动高亮这些国家，方便比较变化

2、语义事件，把用户操作转化为有意义的数据事件

3、交互接口，把图表操作和外部应用状态连起来

比如说，点击图表中的某个产品，旁边的表格、文字和其他图表同步更新，而用户选中的数据也可以传回AI，作为下一轮分析的上下文

过去让AI生成一个带筛选、图表联动的Dashboard，往往需要写大量JavaScript、管理交互状态，再反复调试

现在不必每次都从零实现这些交互逻辑了

Flint-interactive具体做法是它引入了一套语义事件+更新操作符的机制，把“交互要实现什么”与“底层怎么渲染”分开

AI负责描述交互意图，Flint编译器负责处理部分底层事件、图形更新和依赖关系

用Flint-interactive的话，首先可以减少重复开发图表交互代码，另一个用自然语言也可以定制自己的数据分析界面，第三个你不必反复问AI等AI答，自己就能探索数据
